name: blobatar
description: Deterministic geometric blobatars from any string. No dependencies.
//sideEffects: Not `false`. That would license bundlers to drop `import "blobatar/motion.css"` as dead weight, and animated blobatars would silently render static for everyone shipping through a bundler.
//exports: Framework-agnostic JS/TS-only source library. This fork ships `src` and resolves `exports` straight at TS — no build step between a consumer and the source. `dist` (see `main`/`types` below and `scripts/build.ts`) is kept only as an optional bundled fallback for tooling that needs it.

scripts.//golden: Regenerating is a deliberate act, so the script refuses without `--write` and says why. `check` does not call it — `bun test` already asserts against the fixture, which is the direction that matters.
scripts.check: bun test && bun run size && bun run build

author: Alain
